newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Siemens stake in car lock firm.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Siemens stake in car lock firm.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had cleared plans by German industrial giant Siemens AG to take a stake in German company Huelsbeck & Fuerst GmbH.

Siemens said in January it would acquire 25 percent of Huelsbeck & Fuerst GmbH and the same stake in Huelsbeck & Fuerst partner Huf Industrieverwaltung GmbH as part of a plan to boost its position in the market for keyless automobile locks.
The two compoanies manufacture car door handles, steering wheel locks and other mechanical components for car entry systems.
